request.title: Prove exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue and finiteLogFourier_unique (AppB Sec4b sweep)
request.body:
Sweep of `RiemannMasullo/AppB_AnalyticNT/Sec4b.lean` (finite-place log-Fourier and principal-value statements). Only proofs and `private theorem` helpers in this one file; no statement changed.

Closes #3895
Closes #3892

## Proved

- `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue` (Definition B.4.4.1(1), p. 619). The finite Fourier transform is additive and homogeneous on continuous compactly supported functions; with `finiteLogFourier_comp_mul` the scaled pairing is `√‖a‖` times the dilated standard pairing, which is integrable and linear in the test. Continuity is free: the topology of the finite-place tests is the finest locally convex one (`finitePlaceSchwartz_finestTopology` + `continuous_of_finestLocallyConvex`).
- `finiteLogFourier_unique` (Proposition B.4.3.1, p. 618). Every additive test is a Fourier transform (inverse of `schwartzBruhat_fourier_equiv` composed with the self-duality), and `f(0) = ∫ f̂`, so `J - J𝔭` annihilates every test of integral zero. Differences of indicators of balls of equal radius around `x` and `1` are such tests (Haar measure of balls is translation invariant), so the averages of `J - J𝔭` over these balls agree, and continuity off zero together with `J 1 = 0` gives `J x = J𝔭 x`. This uses `finiteLogFourier_eq_neg_haar` (#3891, still `sorry`) by name.

New private helpers (above the declarations they serve): `finiteLogFourier_unique_surjective`, `finiteLogFourier_unique_ballTest`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_fourier_linear`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_ofLinear`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_integrable`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_add`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_smul`, `exists_finiteConnesPrincipalValue_scale`.

## Checks (commands run)

- `lake build RiemannMasullo.AppB_AnalyticNT.Sec4b`: 55 s (52 s before the change).
- `lake build`: passed (18876 jobs).
- `scripts/lint.sh`: ok.
- `lake env lean --run scripts/Signatures.lean RiemannMasullo.AppB_AnalyticNT.Sec4b` before and after, then `scripts/signatures.sh --compare`: no changed declarations.
- `#print axioms`: both theorems show `[propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`. The `sorryAx` comes from existing unproved dependencies: `schwartzBruhat_fourier_equiv` (AppD) and `finiteLocalAdditiveTamagawaMeasure_selfDual` (AppA §3) via the existing helpers `finiteLocal_exists_fourier_test` / `finiteLogFourier_comp_mul`, and, for `finiteLogFourier_unique`, `finiteLogFourier_eq_neg_haar` (#3891).
